extracted.intended_audience: Authors of accepted manuscripts for Acta Mathematica (Mittag‑Leffler)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for preparing and submitting accepted manuscripts to Acta Mathematica, covering style, bibliography, figures, abstract, file naming, and file transfer. Applies to authors finalizing revised manuscripts for publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow journal style and layout
rubrics_metrics.description: Please consult a recent issue of Acta Mathematica to get a general idea of the style and layout. Note that changes other than typographical must be approved by the editor in charge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a recent issue as the model for formatting and layout. Do not make substantive (non‑typographical) changes without the editor's approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliography completeness and relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: We are quite careful with the bibliography. We therefore ask you to fill in any missing data in the reference list, update the references as much as possible, and delete any reference that is not relevant to the current version of your paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all references include full bibliographic details, are up to date, and remove any references not pertinent to the current manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply author instructions when revising
rubrics_metrics.description: When revising your manuscript we ask you to take these author instructions into consideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should incorporate these guidelines during revision; the editorial office expects revisions to conform to the instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Colour figures — print vs online and greyscale visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Acta Mathematica is printed in black and white. If you wish to have figures printed in colour, you have to be prepared to contribute to the extra cost. In the online version colour figures will appear free of charge. If you have colour figures that will be printed in black and white it is important that they are clearly visible in greyscale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect print copies to be B/W unless you pay for colour printing. Prepare figures so they remain legible when converted to greyscale; online publication supports colour at no charge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract required and used online
rubrics_metrics.description: Please make sure that your paper begins with an abstract. The abstract will not be printed, but it will be used on the web. Each paper in Acta Mathematica is presented with abstract and bibliography on the web.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include an abstract at the start of the paper for online presentation, even though it will not appear in the printed journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: TeX file naming convention
rubrics_metrics.description: The name of the TeX file should be the surname of the (first) author with the extension .tex. If the surname has more than eight letters, use only the first eight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Name your primary TeX source file as 'surname.tex' (truncate to first eight letters if the surname is longer) to conform with the journal's processing conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include macros and non‑standard style files
rubrics_metrics.description: Any macros and non-standard style files should be included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bundle all custom macros and any non-standard .sty/.cls files with your submission so the production team can compile the source.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit figures as encapsulated PostScript (EPS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Figures should be submitted separately as encapsulated postscript (.eps) files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide figure files separately in EPS format rather than embedding them solely in the TeX file.

rubrics_metrics.name: File transfer via EditFlow
rubrics_metrics.description: All files are handled through EditFlow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the journal's EditFlow system to upload and manage submission files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions should be addressed to acta@mittag-leffler.se.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct any queries about manuscript preparation or submission to the provided email address.
